feeds.title: Shalyce Tyson Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Shalyce Tyson's blog, a haven of inspiration and relatability. Delve into her glow-getter lifestyle, where she shares personal anecdotes, tips, and recommendations. From motherhood to style, beauty, business, and family fun, explore a myriad of topics curated just for you. Feel free to suggest topics for her to cover and join the journey of connection with other amazing women.

feeds.title: Mattie James Blog
feeds.description: Mattie James, a renowned lifestyle influencer and entrepreneur, offers insights into her daily life and passions on her blog. From family and decor to travel and recipes, she provides diverse content. Follow her for fashion, shopping advice, beauty reviews, and a plethora of lifestyle tips and tricks.

feeds.title: Adriana Lately
feeds.description: Adriana Lately, a go-to resource for millennials navigating life transitions, provides practical advice and solutions. Originally centred on new moms, her blog has expanded into a lifestyle hub covering travel, fashion, beauty, parenting tips, and delectable recipes. Expect insights and hacks tailored for millennial experiences.

feeds.title: Lady Marielle
feeds.description: Family & lifestyle blog about a Haitian-Canadian mom with a passion for food, shopping, and blogging. Join me for delicious recipes, reviews, and blogging tips.

feeds.title: Bianca Dottin Blog
feeds.description: Bianca Dottin, a vibrant lifestyle expert and mama, resides in sunny Orlando, FL. With a degree in Communications from UCF, she's an adventurer passionate about travelling, food, and photography. Through her blog, she inspires moms to embrace motherhood, married life, style, travel, and family recipes, fostering a life they adore, one day at a time.

feeds.title: MadameNoire
feeds.description: MadameNoire, a premier lifestyle website for Black women, debuted in 2010, offering daily doses of inspiration and news. Their mission is to empower women of colour with a wide-ranging content mix, spanning health, fashion, beauty, career, parenting, entertainment, and breaking news.

feeds.title: Her Modern Life » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Welcome to Her Modern Life, where dope brands meet even doper merchandise. Sydnei Jarman, the driving force behind Her Modern Life, is passionate about creating original content and impactful merchandise. With a mission to drive change both online and offline, the brand remains committed to creating, engaging, and informing communities nationwide.

feeds.title: Ria Michelle Blog
feeds.description: Ria Michelle, a Miami-based style blogger and influencer, delves into fashion, food, and travel. Through her blog, she preserves cherished moments and inspires global audiences with her journey. Sharing looks, tips, and hotspots, she captivates with authenticity and creativity, aiming to inspire and connect.

feeds.title: Talking With Tami
feeds.description: Tami Reed, with a flair for fashion and sharp wit, shines in celebrity, lifestyle, and fashion circles. Her expertise attracts partnerships with major brands like K-Mart and Disney. As content chief of TalkingWithTami.com since 2007, she elevates the platform with her passion for entrepreneurship and eye-catching content on celebrities, lifestyle, and fashion.

feeds.title: Joanna E
feeds.description: Joanna E, an IT professional and award-winning travel blogger, runs a lifestyle platform. She shares travel guides, style tips, and beauty insights, inspiring millennial and professional women to prioritize travel despite their busy lives. With passion, she empowers women of colour to pursue their dreams, whether traditional or not.

feeds.title: KP FUSION
feeds.description: Kim Thomas, a Memphis-based lifestyle blogger and photographer, created KPFUSION, a fashion and lifestyle blog with a local twist. Since 2010, she has shared on-trend fashion, beauty tips, and Memphis flavour. Collaborating with brands like Macy's and hosting workshops, Kim's expertise has been featured on ABC 24 Memphis.

feeds.title: GoodTomiCha
feeds.description: Tomi Obebe, a Charlotte-based fashion and lifestyle blogger, runs GoodtoMicha.com, empowering women through style and confidence. With an MBA from Clemson University and corporate digital marketing expertise, Tomi merges business acumen with personal flair, inspiring her audience as a full-time content creator.

feeds.title: Asia Lorea
feeds.description: Asia Lorea, a Black Connecticut mom and lifestyle blogger, shares candid insights on breastfeeding, motherhood, and health. Juggling multiple roles, she offers support to moms navigating similar challenges. Born in Connecticut to Jamaican heritage, she embraces Ghanaian culture through her husband. With a passion for turquoise and exclusive breastfeeding, she empowers mothers to make confident decisions for their families.

feeds.title: Jamila Kyari » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Jamila Kyari Co. inspires vibrant living for women globally. As a digital hub for African fashion, beauty, and lifestyle, it unites a diverse community celebrating African culture. Explore food, fitness, home decor, and more, discovering the essence of African living and fostering wellness and inspiration.

feeds.title: Karisma Ray
feeds.description: Karisma Ray, an Atlanta-based millennial beauty and lifestyle blogger, invites readers to her blog. Offering lifestyle, beauty, and travel insights, she shares personal adventures and tips. Through her platform, she aims to inspire self-love and confidence, empowering readers to navigate life with positivity and purpose.

feeds.title: Life with Tanay
feeds.description: Life with Tanay, born as a hobby in 2014, has blossomed into a comprehensive family lifestyle site. From family travel to entertainment recommendations, they offer diverse content to simplify and enrich family life. With a commitment to well-rounded information, they aim to be your one-stop destination for all things lifestyle, motherhood, self-care, and beyond.

feeds.title: Comfy Girl With Curls
feeds.description: Comfy Girl with Curls, led by Kaya Marriott, is a lifestyle blog centred on natural hair and personal reflections. Based in Vancouver, BC, Kaya, a Black Canadian blogger, offers support and inspiration, touching on beauty, entrepreneurship, and more. Her platform uplifts and empowers others on their journeys, fostering positivity and community.

feeds.title: The Black Princess Diaries » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Meet Deandra, the multifaceted owner of The Black Princess Diaries. As a micro-influencer, podcaster, and entrepreneur, she curates a dynamic platform offering insights, lifestyle tips, beauty trends, and more. Dive into her world of thought-provoking content and empowering narratives.

feeds.title: Blackprint Blog » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Blackprint.com, a lifestyle brand, intertwines culture and luxury seamlessly. With deep roots in cultural appreciation and a commitment to luxury experiences, it offers a curated journey for discerning individuals seeking both style and substance.

feeds.title: Life By Wyetha
feeds.description: Life By Wyetha, a lifestyle blog helmed by creator Wyetha, delves into the pursuit of happiness through faith and life lessons. With a focus on home-life, diabetes management, and self-love, Wyetha shares insights on photography, horror movies, decorating, and more. Join her journey towards holistic well-being and fulfilment.
